description: This file contains tests for the local storage implementation of workflow executions, including setup, storage, querying, and hierarchy retrieval, as well as utility functions related to search sanitization and state transition validation.

methods.name: setupLocalStorage
methods.description: Sets up a LocalStorage instance for testing, initializing it with a temporary directory and returning it with a context.

methods.name: TestQueryWorkflowExecutionsFiltersAndSearch
methods.description: Tests querying workflow executions with various filters, search terms, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: TestQueryWorkflowDAGReturnsHierarchy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of workflow execution hierarchy (DAG) for a given root workflow ID.

methods.name: TestSanitizeFTS5Query
methods.description: Tests sanitization of user-provided search queries for full-text search to prevent injection and syntax issues.

methods.name: TestValidateExecutionStateTransition
methods.description: Tests validation logic for allowed transitions between execution states.
